title: Ammo Press and Guns
description: With casting available through the &3Crucible&r, many gun parts can now be created such as &6Barrels&r and &6Grips&r. An &3Ammo Press&r is used to create the various ammunitions guns use.
A &3Weapon Modification Table&r can be used to install weapon mods, such as &6Silencers&r and &6Scopes&r.
The &6Bullet Casing Bag&r will retrieve some of the casings when guns are fired.
